material.head: Weekly: wave 2 in its buy zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Jun 16, 2022 to Oct 30, 2025 (+114%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+5.8% to −8.3%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Oct 30, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−26%); a close over the wave-1 high (+58%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
